second_place_line_selection.scope: Chronological replays with established models and fixed coeff; Brier diagnostic given actual winner, never a forecasting input.

main.definitions: Winner is used as a post-outcome input only for line-probability diagnostic, never the ticket ranking. Exact first to third ordering is scored for each ticket. Different/same use the actual pairing and are retrospective classes.

historical.method: Rows with multi-rider actual winner line only. Frozen odds conditioned on actual winner for diagnosis only. Quantile partition uses old pre-start cross probability, not outcomes.

historical_timed.method: Rows with multi-rider actual winner line only. Frozen odds conditioned on actual winner for diagnosis only. Quantile partition uses old pre-start cross probability, not outcomes.

current.method: Rows with multi-rider actual winner line only. Frozen odds conditioned on actual winner for diagnosis only. Quantile partition uses old pre-start cross probability, not outcomes.

exploratory_other_lines.diagnostics: Extra transfer hypothesis after inspecting the two-stage replay. No coefficients refit. Replays only; possible live forecast bytes were fixed before inspecting this diagnostic score.

race_stage.archived_source_assumption: Historical labels published as Kdreams race category were read retrospectively from role-identified historical program. Available capture timestamps are after cutoff; the strict recent arms compare older sealed input records separately.

definitions.dedup_first_ticket_rank: Distinct ordered first-two pairs in order of first appearance in the original full trifecta ranking. Equivalently ranked by their best trifecta, not by summing all possible third places.
definitions.summed_pair_probability_rank: Ordered first-two pair ranked by its probability summed over all possible third places. Tie broken by ordered car number.
definitions.interpretation: This is a post-outcome count of ticket coverage, not evidence of a new better forecast. Analysis uses the fixed current-distribution Nov21–24 287-race replay only.

official_home_back_and_first_two_errors.method: Post-race description. H and B leaders are individual cars from KEIRIN.JP. The mapped line is their pre-race declaration. H/B leader line change does not locate a move or show who followed. No target H/B or finish values can be used as forecast inputs.

attenuation.measurements: total variation distance between identical model inputs with original H vs B prior
